property_summary: For any admissible input, an actor that is not the token owner, an approved address, or an approved operator can never change a token's ownership (transferFrom reverts and ownerOf stays the owner); the mutant removes the authorization check, letting any caller seize ownership of tokens held by the maker.
change_summary: Delete the authorization require so any caller can transfer any token, changing `_ownerOf` for tokens they do not own.
